requirement.statement: The project SHALL provide an interpreter runtime that uses the versioned depa-actor@0.2.0 package contract as its generic execution substrate without a machine-specific or repository-local file dependency.

case.given: depa-actor@0.2.0 is configured as a registry dependency
case.then: The runtime SHALL import depa-actor primitives for instruction stack, operand stack, and generic dispatch from that versioned package contract.

case.given: depa-actor exposes stack/frame and dispatch primitives
case.then: The runtime SHALL reuse the depa-actor primitives instead of duplicating generic stack or dispatcher implementations.

case.given: A caller uses the existing Interpreter API
case.then: The existing interpreter path SHALL remain behaviorally unchanged.
